Our platform hangs during cold boot in ARM Trusted Firmware (TF-A) BL31 when trying to bring up secondary CPUs via PSCI CPU_ON. The primary CPU (CPU0) boots fine through BL1->BL2->BL31->BL33->kernel, but the PSCI CPU_ON call for CPU1-7 never returns.

UART log (BL31 debug level):
[BL31] PSCI: CPU_ON request for MPIDR=0x100 (CPU1)
[BL31] psci_cpu_on_start: target affinity=0x100
[BL31] psci_cpu_on_start: setting target state to ON_PENDING
[BL31] css_pwr_domain_on: writing PPONR for cluster0.cpu1
[BL31] css_pwr_domain_on: polling PSTATE for cpu1...
[BL31] css_pwr_domain_on: TIMEOUT waiting for cpu1 PSTATE (stuck at OFF)
[BL31] PSCI: CPU_ON for 0x100 failed: PSCI_E_INTERN_FAIL

SCP firmware log (if available via MHU):
[SCP] PD_ON request received for PD3 (cpu1)
[SCP] PPU: setting PD3 to ON... voltage check FAIL
[SCP] PPU: VDD_CPU1 rail not detected (PMIC channel 3)
[SCP] PD_ON denied for PD3

This is a new board revision where the PMIC was changed. The SCP firmware seems to be checking voltage rails that don't match the new PMIC layout.
